objective: Prove the morphology-calibrated canonical CW10 asset in an isolated same-seed Minecraft 1.21.1 pair without touching Aero or production worlds.

world_pair.baseline: fresh disposable Terrain Diffusion Minecraft world
world_pair.candidate: exact reflink/clone of the stopped baseline before CW10 application

application_policy.phase: explicit operator command after target plus halo chunks are FULL and baseline clone is frozen
application_policy.air_class: write source air only into solid nonfluid blocks while preserving gravity supports and fluid boundaries
application_policy.water_class: write source water only into solid nonfluid blocks while preserving gravity supports
application_policy.missing_or_corrupt_cache: refuse entire application before any write

performance_evidence.comparison_scope: one 256x256 candidate region plus one-chunk halo; not an unbounded server throughput claim

visual_evidence: same seed same camera vanilla versus CW10 vertical cross-section
same seed same camera top-down cave elevation
canonical portable mesh beside Minecraft block result
first-person entrance trunk chamber and water-table views
mobile-safe PNG and desktop interactive viewer
stop_rules: do not launch without a valid separately scoped worldgen grant
stop before application if any cache asset release or world identity differs
stop on any missing FULL chunk
stop on any Aero health regression
do not promote on a failed automated gate regardless of visual preference
